value: Stomp game featuring highschool characters. Includes several different game modes.

Game 1 features several levels with different gameplay:
Levels 1-4: Dodge stomping attacks for 60 seconds to survive.
Levels 5-6: Clean up giant feet with limited stamina.
Level 7: Vore scene inspired by Little Snatcher.
Level 8: Dodge stomps left and right for 80 seconds.
Level 9: Survive a stomping massacre as the only tiny left.

Game 2 focuses more on collecting scraps in a small map, with a handful of game over scenarios.
